purpose: Reference architecture evidence, not a vulnerability advisory or vehicle compatibility claim.

evidence_classes.primary_documentation: Published by the project or standards/product organization.
evidence_classes.source_observation: Ordinary static source reading at a pinned commit; not decompilation.
evidence_classes.rea_artifact_observation: REA static package inventory; no execution or semantic decompilation.
evidence_classes.design_choice: Original GW-01 research design; requires local validation.
evidence_classes.simulation_result: A measurement of a named local simulator build, never a production-vehicle vulnerability.

sources.title: OVMS3 introduction and hardware
supports: ESP32 Xtensa LX6 base hardware and three builtin CAN buses
Web UI, mobile clients and MQTT integration
limitations: Documentation describes integrations; no hardware was connected or tested.

sources.title: The OVMS Web UI
supports: WebSocket channel for metrics, events and logs
limitations: Not evidence that GW-01 implements the OVMS wire protocol.

sources.title: OVMS OTA build versions
limitations: Downloaded main artifact was not booted; exact source/build equivalence is unknown.

sources.title: OvmsVehicle and OvmsVehicleFactory declarations

anchors.observation: Vehicle interface exposes CAN bus handles.
IncomingFrameCan1 through IncomingFrameCan4 are virtual entry points.

limitations: Declarations establish interfaces, not complete runtime dispatch behavior.

sources.title: CAN frame and bus interfaces

anchors.observation: CAN_frame_t declares origin, message ID and eight payload bytes.
Frame input, listeners and callbacks are separate interfaces.

limitations: GW-01 uses independent synthetic messages; no OEM frame mapping is derived or distributed.

sources.title: OVMS event interface

anchors.observation: OvmsEvents declares event registration and signal overloads.

limitations: No callback ordering or queue liveness conclusion is drawn from the declarations.

sources.title: OVMS metrics interface
limitations: No source-to-firmware equivalence was established.

limitations: These conditions do not establish bit-identical behavior across engines, hardware or versions.

limitations: GW-01 message objects are not electrically or bit-level conformant CAN hardware.

sources.title: Control units
supports: ECUs process sensors and control actuators
limitations: Vendor overview is context, not a model of every vehicle or safety certification.

sources.title: Zone ECU
supports: Zonal ECUs connect centralized computers with distributed ECUs, sensors and actuators
limitations: GW-01 topology is illustrative, not a reproduction of Bosch hardware.

sources.title: Specification of Secure Onboard Communication Protocol
supports: Authenticity and freshness are separate checks above underlying communication
SecOC requires sending and receiving ECU participation
limitations: GW-01 is not an AUTOSAR implementation or SecOC conformance test.

sources.title: Officially linked OVMS Android APK releases
limitations: Package signature was not verified; HTTPS origin and digest are retained.

sources.title: CARLA coordinate systems and transformations
supports: Left-handed ground-plane convention: X forward, Y right, Z up
limitations: Documented coordinate contract, not runtime physics validation.

artifacts.status: REA static archive inventory completed; semantic decompilation unavailable
limitations: ZIP central-directory inventory only.
No signature verification, execution, permission decoding, method decompilation or data-flow analysis.
JADX subprocess ownership unavailable on Windows ARM64.

claims.statement: OVMS separates vehicle-facing interfaces, CAN transport, metrics and events.
claims.boundary: Interface declarations only; no call graph or runtime ordering claim.

claims.statement: CARLA control input is normalized, and a physics wheel-angle observation is a distinct API.
claims.boundary: No GW-01 angle measurement is presumed to be a production steering sensor.

claims.statement: Synchronous fixed-step operation has specific reproducibility prerequisites.
claims.boundary: A local backend repeatability test must still be executed.

claims.statement: Official OVMS APK contains AndroidManifest.xml, classes.dex and classes2.dex entries.
claims.boundary: Presence does not establish runtime behavior.

claims.statement: GW-01 uses an original synthetic command protocol with deterministic validation before simulator actuation.
claims.boundary: Conceptual motivation only; no SecOC or vehicle compatibility claim.

claims.statement: GW-01 virtual ECU roles and vehicle profiles are independent educational models.
claims.boundary: No production ECU instruction set, OEM CAN payload, firmware image or real actuation connector is part of the platform.

unknowns: Firmware instructions and pseudocode were not recovered.
APK classes and permissions were not decoded.
No production-vehicle behavior, vulnerability, remote-control path or attack resilience was tested.
CARLA SDK installation and mocked adapter contracts do not establish server execution; no end-to-end CARLA server run was available.
No bit-level CAN, electromagnetic behavior, ECU scheduler or tire-model fidelity is claimed.
